confirmed: Read the entire markdown conversion and checked the relevant PDF pages, including the figures omitted from markdown. The PDF has 19 pages, ends with references, and contains no appendix or embedded supplement (PDF pp. 1-19).

The source is arXiv:2409.14228v1, dated 21 Sep 2024, in a CHI 2025 template with placeholder DOI XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX; the title and all seven author names match the form (PDF p. 1, title block, arXiv stamp, and ACM reference).

Randomized, counterbalanced within-person condition order is explicit: each student used Mentigo and a basic agent with simple prompts on Smart Home and Low-Carbon Campus tasks. This is an ai_design comparison with scored human output, so has_randomized_people_study is true (PDF p. 10, Sections 5.1-5.2; p. 11, Section 5.3.2).

lab_rct is appropriate under the codebook definition of a supervised session: the remote Tencent Meeting sessions had a researcher present. context_class=none and core=no are appropriate for this small randomized experiment (PDF p. 10, Sections 5.1-5.2).

The experiment recruited 12 students, ages 12-14, comprising 6 males and 6 females; Table 4 lists P1-P12 in grades 7-9. These are the same people in both conditions, not two independent samples of 12 (PDF p. 10, Section 5.1; p. 11, Table 4).

Two students did not complete the final two stages using Mentigo, and their incomplete data were excluded. The paper does not state an outcome-specific analyzed count or clearly establish the scope of this exclusion, so null analyzed counts are justified; every experiment analysis is below 50 people (PDF p. 14, Section 6.3).

The system-development corpus involved 57 students and 12 human mentors, with 2,362 interaction sequences; these are separate from the randomized user-study sample. Five formative educators and five expert reviewers also must not be added to the experimental student count (PDF p. 3, Section 3.1; p. 5, Section 4.1; p. 9, Section 4.3.1; p. 12, Section 5.4).

The model is printed as OpenAI GPT-4o API, version 2024-08-06. The protocol gives 30 minutes per task, while the task-session heading gives 30-40 minutes each, as the form notes (PDF p. 10, Sections 4.3.2 and 5.2; p. 11, continued task protocol).

Three researchers rated the learning reports. S1-O1.reported and the one-line finding reproduce the printed report-score results exactly: Mentigo M = 13.43, SD = 3.17; baseline M = 10.74, SD = 2.72; independent samples t-test, p = 0.016. No analyzed n accompanies this comparison (PDF p. 11, Section 5.3.2; p. 13, Section 6.2 below Table 7).

S1-O2.reported matches Table 8: Creation, Mentigo Mdn = 7.5, baseline Mdn = 2, U = 81.5, p = 0.0180*. The coding definition is creating new ideas using what has just been learned (PDF p. 15, Table 8; p. 12, Table 5).

S1-O3.reported matches Table 7: post-test Mentigo 6.67 (2.19), baseline 5 (1.91), effect size 0.77*, p = 0.019*; the text prints Cohen’s d = 0.765 and identifies the Mann-Whitney U test. The methods describe self-rated CPS knowledge, correctly distinguished from scored creative output (PDF p. 13, Table 7 and Section 6.2; p. 11, Section 5.3.1).

The paper refers to supplementary evaluation-matrix details and an interview protocol, with no URL supplied in those passages; those materials are absent from this PDF. This is an original empirical paper, not a synthesis, so the synthesis defaults are appropriate (PDF p. 11, Section 5.3.2; p. 12, Section 5.3.4; complete PDF).
summary: The randomized within-person study of 12 students belongs in the two-screener pipeline but remains below the core sample threshold. All reported numbers and the source version match; corrections concern AI-role coding and how learning-report outcomes are represented.
